note: Small quiet state park on Brule Creek, 11 mi south of Beresford off I-29 Exit 38: well-shaded electric sites in a wooded loop, three tent-only sites, and a separate four-site horse camp about 700 m east. Horse/bike and hiking trails along the creek; hunting is allowed in the park Oct 1-Apr 30. --Claude
